## Ticket proposals
- **preview_start's port-reuse can silently serve the wrong worktree** — suggested P3; created as [[BAD-091]] at P2 by Spud.
  Why: Root cause of BAD-055: mcp__Claude_Browser__preview_start's own description says it 'Reuses the server if already running.' That reuse is scoped to the port (8901, hardcoded in scripts/web-server.js and pinned in .claude/launch.json's web entry, no per-worktree override), not to the caller's checkout. A worktree session gets no error and no signal that it attached to another checkout's process -- it just silently serves that tree. Documentation (this ticket) tells agents to check what they got, but a tooling fix would prevent the footgun rather than rely on every agent remembering to verify.
  Evidence: BAD-044 (2026-09-15): preview_start name=web from a worktree served main's app.js (1909 lines, 1 <script> tag) instead of the worktree's own (176 lines, 12 tags); npm run web from inside the worktree served the worktree correctly. scripts/web-server.js:24 ROOT = path.join(__dirname, '..'); .claude/launch.json's web entry sets no PORT/cwd override; preview_start tool description: 'Reuses the server if already running.' Two possible fixes: have .claude/launch.json's web entry pick a free/worktree-scoped port, or have preview_start verify the served content's origin/cwd matches before reusing a process.

## Result

Verified mechanism: scripts/web-server.js roots ROOT on path.join(__dirname,'..') (its own script location, not cwd), port 8901 is hardcoded with no per-worktree override in .claude/launch.json's web entry, and preview_start's own tool description says it 'Reuses the server if already running' -- so the bug is port-scoped reuse across checkouts, not a cwd-resolution bug. Deviated from the brief on one point: the brief's CORS justification for port 8901 ("it is the origin the production catalog's CORS allows") is false -- the showcase/catalog bucket's CORS is a wildcard GET/HEAD from '*' and the render service's CORS explicitly excludes localhost:8901 (that's why web:live/8902 exists). I wrote the true reason instead (8901 is the one hardcoded default every script/doc assumes; only one process machine-wide can hold it) and filed proposal 125 for the tooling gap (preview_start's reuse has no per-worktree awareness). Diff proofread clean; every path/command/port cited (scripts/web-server.js, .claude/launch.json, npm run web, port 8901) is real and re-verified.
